the 4C’s (communication, collaboration, critical thinking, and creativity) are the skills that are necessary in the 21st century.

the following questions: What are 21st century skills, and why are they important for language teachers to know about? How can 21st century learning skills be incorporated into a language curriculum? How can language teachers assess 21st century skill development?
the following questions: 1. What is meant by the 21 st century? 2. What is meant 21 st century language teaching? 3. What are the skills that are required in the 21st century?
the question: how can language teachers help their students develop the 21st century skills that will help them become effective global citizens?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the 21st century is the century of language teaching and learning and the teacher has to be equipped with all necessary skills, knowledge and attitudes to be able to meet the challenges of the century.
21 st century learners are expected to be competent and proficient in four key areas: communication, collaboration, critical thinking and creativity.
the twenty first century has seen an unprecedented increase in the number of people speaking more than one language.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 21st century skills can be integrated into the language teaching curriculum.
the 21st century has brought about a new set of skills which have become essential for the learner to develop in order to be able to communicate, collaborate and be creative.
the 21st century is the age of globalisation, where the world has become a small village.

language teaching is no longer a field that is concerned only with helping learners acquire a second language.
